result.instructions: Tools for Gumroad, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gumroad data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run gumroad_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gumroad_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gumroad_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. gumroad_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gumroad_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user associated with the current Gumroad access token. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/user.

tools.name: gumroad_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List all of the authenticated user's products. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products.

tools.name: gumroad_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List/filter the authenticated user's successful sales, most recent first. Supports date, email, product/order filters and cursor pagination via page_key. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/sales.

after.description: Only sales after this date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only sales before this date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

email.description: Filter to sales to this buyer email.

product_id.description: Filter to sales of this product id.

order_id.description: Filter to a specific order id.

page_key.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous response's next_page_key to fetch the next page.

tools.name: gumroad_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: Get a single sale by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/sales/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List a membership/subscription product's subscribers, optionally filtered by buyer email. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/subscribers.

email.description: Filter to the subscriber with this buyer email.

tools.name: gumroad_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: Get a single subscriber by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/subscribers/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_offer_codes
tools.title: List offer codes
tools.description: List a product's offer codes (discount codes). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes.

tools.name: gumroad_get_offer_code
tools.title: Get offer code
tools.description: Get a single offer code on a product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_variant_categories
tools.title: List variant categories
tools.description: List a product's variant categories (option groups). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/variant_categories.

tools.name: gumroad_get_variant_category
tools.title: Get variant category
tools.description: Get a single variant category on a product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/variant_categories/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List a product's custom fields (extra fields collected at checkout). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/custom_fields.

tools.name: gumroad_list_resource_subscriptions
tools.title: List resource subscriptions
tools.description: List the authenticated user's resource subscriptions (webhooks) for a given resource/event name. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/resource_subscriptions.

resource_name.description: The resource/event name whose webhook subscriptions to list.

tools.name: gumroad_verify_license
tools.title: Verify license
tools.description: Verify a license key for a product (checks validity and returns purchase details). By default this does NOT increment the uses count; with increment_uses_count: true it records a use (a write). Gumroad REST: POST /v2/licenses/verify.

product_id.description: The product id the license belongs to.

increment_uses_count.description: Whether to increment the license's uses count (default false — pass true to record a use).

tools.name: gumroad_enable_product
tools.title: Enable product
tools.description: Enable (publish) a product so it can be sold. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{id}/enable.

tools.name: gumroad_disable_product
tools.title: Disable product
tools.description: Disable (unpublish) a product so it can no longer be sold. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{id}/disable.

tools.name: gumroad_create_offer_code
tools.title: Create offer code
tools.description: Create a new offer code (discount code) on a product. Gumroad REST: POST /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes.

product_id.description: The product id to create the offer code on.

name.description: The discount code text buyers enter (e.g. LAUNCH20).

amount_off.description: The amount off — in cents when offer_type is 'cents', or a percentage when 'percent'.

offer_type.description: Whether amount_off is a fixed amount in 'cents' or a 'percent' discount (default 'cents').

max_purchase_count.description: Optional cap on how many times the offer code can be used.

universal.description: Whether the offer code applies to all of the user's products (default false).

tools.name: gumroad_update_offer_code
tools.title: Update offer code
tools.description: Update an existing offer code on a product (its code text and/or its max purchase count). Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes/{id}.

product_id.description: The product id the offer code belongs to.

id.description: The offer code id to update.

max_purchase_count.description: New cap on how many times the offer code can be used.

tools.name: gumroad_enable_license
tools.title: Enable license
tools.description: Enable a product's license key. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/licenses/enable.

product_id.description: The product id the license belongs to.

tools.name: gumroad_disable_license
tools.title: Disable license
tools.description: Disable a product's license key. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/licenses/disable.

product_id.description: The product id the license belongs to.
